status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
The problem is introduced by IGNITE-5170, where * was added to assembly version, but the bug was there forever: in BinaryWriter we have

            if (!desc.IsRegistered)
                WriteString(type.AssemblyQualifiedName);

We should not write assembly qualified name, which is explained in IGNITE-5172.
